|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-05-Yub_Yub_Commander.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-yubyubcommander-pre.gif]]). The later errata version is [[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “USED: ▼ a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot. LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Squadron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. OR If two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 37)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Yub Yub, Commander (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) spells “Rogue Sqaudron” (typo as published) and writes “Or if”. PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1273_35">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “USED: ▼ a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot. LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Sqaudron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. Or if two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
